name: archive-us
description: US archival practice (DACS/EAD) as timetwister reads it: numeric dates are month-first, seasons run equinox to solstice (spring 1776 = 20 March to 21 June) with winter at the start of the year (January to 20 March), and decade bands overlap as halves (early 0-5, mid 3-8, late 5-9).
